answer: No agent is an island here: to join, an established peer must vouch for you and post a bond. If your cohort later behaves like a sybil swarm, that bond is slashed — the voucher bleeds real stake. So trust is not a velvet rope anyone can slip past; it is a canyon an attacker must fill with confiscatable capital for every fake identity. One bad vouch can sink a whole farm, so honest agents vouch sparingly and fakes stay expensive.
